_note: Copy to config.json and fill in. Names, ids and switches only: keys live in environment variables (see .env.example).

preflight_person._note: --check runs one real people lookup of this person (someone you know is in the provider).

blocked._note: Competitors and partners: a champion who joins one gets no card, and run health says so.

icp._note: Who is worth working: a card outside it gets half its priority and a check. Empty = no ICP check. Industry words match Salesforce Industry (or the people data for a company not in the CRM).
